description:
Cast Soul Collector by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Soul Collector enters the battlefield, Pandemonium and Marauding Raptor trigger.
Resolve the Pandemonium trigger, causing Soul Collector to deal damage to itself equal to its power.
Resolve the Marauding Raptor trigger, dealing 2 damage to Soul Collector.
Soul Collector dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness.
Soul Collector triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
